description: SECURITY (s441, S440 F4 in a handler body). An inline event handler passes the server function `isOk` as a value to a user function, which calls it and tests the result — an unawaited Promise, always truthy ("accepted" for every input). Ruled S440 (F4): an async-colored function may not escape as a value; the rule is enforced in handler bodies too (S440 JS-WAT #11).
rationale: §13.2: an async-colored function SHALL NOT be used as a value; passing a server function to a function that is not an awaited collection method SHALL be a compile error (E-ASYNC-FN-ESCAPES-AS-VALUE, §34), in every body the compiler emits.
